killedBy: verify.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute installs the override on BOTH of its page paths, before either navigates
why: Leaves the two real `AudioContext`s the app builds at boot -- Howler's, when `createAudioEngine` first touches `Howler.volume()`, and `engine.ts`'s `ensureCtx`. On a host whose audio service never connects each constructor returns only after an internal 20-second timeout, so the page blocks for ~40 s before `load` fires and the board sweep's page boots the app unguarded. The other half of the pair above: here the clearance measurements still come back and every screenshot viewport times out instead.
